params.name: endMs
params.description: Time in unix milliseconds that represents the end of time range of messages to return. Used in combination with durationMs. Defaults to now.

params.name: durationMs
params.description: Time in milliseconds that represents the duration before endMs to query. Defaults to 24 hours.
